steps.en: Build the client and exit binary
steps.zh: 构建客户端与出口程序

steps.en: Configure both peers with an authorized carrier and matching secret
steps.zh: 为两端配置获准通道和一致密钥

steps.en: Connect the client and exit through the selected carrier
steps.zh: 通过所选通道连接客户端与出口

steps.en: Point an authorized application at the local SOCKS5 listener
steps.zh: 让获授权应用使用本地 SOCKS5 入口

steps.en: Carry IPv4 packets to your exit and connect to the destination
steps.zh: 承载 IPv4 包到你的出口并连接目的服务

value.en: Change carriers without rebuilding the application packet path
value.zh: 切换承载通道而不重写应用数据包路径
